findings.evidence: Row sets version_status="published". Per c2, "published" requires the maintainer to publish a release identifier for this board that the version copies. SOURCE 1 (protocol text) names no release identifier for the board; SOURCE 2 metadata contains only last_updated="2026-09-27" and total_tasks=102, neither a release identifier. A page publishing no release identifier supports "snapshot", so "published" is a mismatch.
findings.repair: Change version_status to "snapshot" and version to the dated identity snapshot-<capture date> unless a maintainer release identifier is supplied.
